decisions.why: categories Gastrostomy & Jejunostomy and Feeding Tubes plus examples Bottle Adaptor, Extension Sets and Female ENFit Caps are enteral feeding devices and tubes
categories Slide Sheets, Air Assisted Devices and Transfer Boards, with examples Flo F3 and FloJac air-assisted transfer mattresses, are lateral transfer/slide-sheet products
categories Stone Management, Access Products and Dilation Products with examples Chiba Needle, Initial Puncture Needle and Nano Glide Hydrophilic Guidewire are stone retrieval and access devices
category Dressing plus examples Hydrocyn Aqua, Air Note odour-neutralising patch and the Curea P1/P2 range are advanced wound dressings
